Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: jsthntn247; Posted: Nov 4, 2019; He used to run them in Lapua large-primer brass, seated about as far out as SGK, who was touching at CBTO 2.276. No velocity. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 308 Win.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: SGK; Posted: May 4, 2019; Single round, fired April 15, 2019. CBTO 2.228, first called a 50 thou jump and later revised to 48 thou. He warned Two Box placement can throw the absolute velocity off. No pressure signs. Blaser R8 Professional Success, 1:11 twist. He called the barrel 23 in (580 mm). Lapua standard 308 Win brass. He did not name a primer.
